The '''Saleucami system ''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The system contained the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]] and the [[Star/Legends|star]], [[Stisste/Legends|Stisste]].<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the Saleucami system was the theater of a [[Battle above Saleucami|battle]] concluded with a Sith victory.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=space|Saleucami Fleet Action}}</ref>
